summary: Implemented the M2 Redis cache and fixed-window rate-limit foundations: CacheConfig (env-driven, frozen, URL credential redaction), KeyValueCache Protocol, RedisCache with injectable client and CacheUnavailable error mapping, InMemoryCache with injected-clock expiry; RateLimitPolicy/Result, RateLimiter Protocol, RedisRateLimiter using INCR plus first-call EXPIRE with window+1 slack, and an equivalent InMemoryRateLimiter. Added redis>=5.0, 15 stub-based tests plus 2 CACHE_REDIS_URL-gated integration tests, CI Redis URL from docker-compose.dev.yml host mapping (port 6380, no password), and cache/rate-limit documentation.
contracts_changed: services/api/clipos_api/cache.py: CacheConfigurationError, CacheUnavailable, CacheConfig, KeyValueCache (Protocol), RedisCache, InMemoryCache
services/api/clipos_api/rate_limit.py: RateLimitPolicy, RateLimitResult, RateLimiter (Protocol), RedisRateLimiter, InMemoryRateLimiter

tests.evidence: 160 passed, 4 skipped (2 MinIO integration and 2 Redis integration are honestly environment-gated in the no-network/no-Docker sandbox); coverage 88.84% vs 60% floor. Prior observed run was 146 passed, 2 skipped; 16 additional collected tests (12 unit test functions including 3 contract parametrizations, plus 2 gated integrations).

tests.name: redis_gated_integration
tests.evidence: Two CACHE_REDIS_URL-gated integration tests skipped because the sandbox has no Docker/network. Orchestrator must run them with CACHE_REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380/0 against compose Redis.

known_limitations: Redis fixed-window rate limiting uses INCR followed by EXPIRE only on the first increment; a crash in between can leave that first key without TTL. Sliding-window/token-bucket behavior is explicitly future work.
InMemoryCache/InMemoryRateLimiter are single-process fallbacks and are not distributed-safe.
No HTTP middleware or route wiring is included; route admission via limiter.allow() is documented as future API-ticket work.
CACHE_REDIS_URL-gated integration tests did not run in this sandbox; orchestrator must rerun them against real Redis.
